description: Polybrominated Diphenyl Ethers in Canadian Municipal Wastewater Treatment Systems is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. This data set contains concentrations of polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) in wastewater Influent (INF), Effluent (EFF), Landfill Leachate (LCH), Biosolids (BIOS) and Sludge (SLG) sampled from various Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTPs) and Landfills across Canada. Scientific Publications: Kim, M.; Guerra, P.; Theocharides, M.; Barclay, K.; Smyth, S. A.; Alaee, M. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Eaux usées, Boues, Biosolides, L'influent brut, Effluent primaire. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2023-02-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
